segments.text:
V. 10.
When ye have done all, ſay, We are unprofitable ſervants— For a Man cannot profit GOD. Happy is he who judges himſelf an unprofitable Servant: Miſerable is he, whom GOD pronounces ſuch. But tho' we are unprofitable to Him, our ſerving him is not unprofitable to us. For he is pleaſed to give by his Grace a Value to our Good Works, which in Conſequence of his Promiſe, intitles us to an eternal Reward.
